_comment: Published reference data for the courses in assets/courses, keyed by course id. osm_checks.py compares every import against it.
metres: along the line of play from the tee set named in 'tees' -- that is how golf measures a hole, so a dogleg's number is longer than the straight tee-to-pin distance.
bearing_deg (or faces: N, NE, ... NNW): the compass direction from tee to green, 0 north, 90 east. Optional per hole.
sources: where the numbers come from; confidence: how far to trust them and how they were taken.
OSM tee polygons are usually the whole teeing ground rather than one marker, so expect generated distances a little short of championship numbers.

himmerland_new_course.name: Himmerland New Course
himmerland_new_course.confidence: Medium. Pars and back-tee metres from a third-party scorecard (GolfPass), not the club's own; the pars match OSM's ref-tagged hole ways, par 6 on the 11th included. Formerly the Backtee course.

horsens_golfklub.name: Horsens Golfklub
horsens_golfklub.confidence: Medium. Pars and yellow-tee lengths from a third-party scorecard, not the club's own. The site labels them yards, but they are metres: they match OSM's hole lines to a few metres. Its hole 14 (125 m) is shorter than its own blue tee (145 m); OSM's line for 14 (168 m) matches the white tee (173 m).

horsens_par_3.name: Horsens Par 3
horsens_par_3.confidence: Medium. Nine par 3s in metres from GolfPass; GolfingRecord agrees but for hole 1 (183 m). OSM's lines run 10-25% shorter than both, as if drawn from forward tees.

marienlyst_golfklub.name: Marienlyst Golfklub
marienlyst_golfklub.confidence: High. Six par 3s, lengths from the club's own course page; bearings measured tee to flag on the club's north-up satellite course map (about +-10 degrees). The club's lengths are rounded and from the mats; OSM's lines run 10-20% short on holes 1 and 5.

kalo_golf_club.name: Kalø Golf Club
kalo_golf_club.confidence: Pars and lengths: the club's official 18-hole scorecard, tee 61. OSM's golf=hole ways carry the same par, handicap and dist:* tags (dist:white on hole 1 is a typo, 3874). Bearings: from those ref-tagged OSM ways oriented to their pin nodes; no club course map was reachable.

kalo_par_3.name: Kalø Par 3
kalo_par_3.confidence: Medium. The club says 9 par-3 holes of about 80-150 m; per-hole lengths are OSM's dist:yellow tags on the P1-P9 golf=hole ways and bearings are those ways oriented to their pin nodes. No club scorecard or map with per-hole figures was found.

mollerup_golf_club.name: Mollerup Golf Club
mollerup_golf_club.confidence: High. Pars and lengths: the club's scorecard, tee 57 (golfpass lists the same holes in yards). Bearings: tee to green on the club's course overview map (north to the left; about +-10 degrees). OSM's hole ways carry no ref, par or name, so the play order in osm_golf_config.json was matched to that map line by line.

mollerup_par_3.name: Mollerup Par 3
mollerup_par_3.confidence: High for count and order: the club calls it its '6 hullers par 3 bane' (6 holes, par 18), and the owner, who plays it, confirmed the routing (1 by the road, 2 south-east, 3 south, 4 and 5 back north on the west side, 6 from a tee west of the water to the green by the road). No published per-hole lengths (golfify's 300 m each is a placeholder); hole 6's 90 m and direction are the owner's.
